## TemplateEngine.\_processImportBlocks() method

Parses `<import>` directives from a template and extracts import metadata.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processImportBlocks(template: string): {
        processed: string;
        imports: {
            src: string;
            blocks?: string | string[];
            base: string;
            lang?: string;
            section: `all` | `value`;
            indent: string;
        }[];
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ processed: string; imports: { src: string; blocks?: string \| string\[\]; base: string; lang?: string; section: \`all\` \| \`value\`; indent: string; }\[\]; }

An object containing the processed template with placeholders and an array of import metadata

## Remarks

This internal method identifies all `<import>` tags in a template and replaces them with placeholders while collecting their metadata (src, blocks, base, lang, section, indent). The placeholders are later resolved by `processImportBlocks`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const template = '<import src="other-page" block="message" />';
const { processed, imports } = TemplateEngine._processImportBlocks(template);
// processed: '__IMPORT_0__'
// imports: [{ src: 'other-page', blocks: 'message', base: 'default', ... }]
```
